selection.size_measure: Total proposed homes in each application, across all its phases. Counts do not imply homes are completed or currently for sale.
selection.coverage: Fifteen large residential proposals selected from non-closed City applications, using proposed home totals across each application and its phases. This is a sourced selection, not an exhaustive current citywide ranking. Report dates are shown because designs and counts can change.
selection.excluded: 24-0286-00 Gateway is Concluded in current City GIS. Georgetown West uses 2,079 homes in the September 2025 report, replacing an older 2,208 count.
selection.geometry: All selected applications have official site outlines. Models are available only where source-plan massing has been prepared and recorded in proposed-building-sources.json. An application boundary is not a building footprint.

projects.title: Guildford Town Centre redevelopment
projects.headline: Proposed: 4,652 homes · 11 towers
projects.summary: Proposal for 11 towers with 4,652 homes, 28,466 m² of commercial space and a future school and park site.

projects.title: Bristol Estates

latest_addition.method: Reviewed unit-count descriptions and larger multi-building masterplans whose GIS descriptions omit totals; verified selected counts in official City planning reports. Counts are report snapshots, not a guarantee of current design or market availability. Selected one general application per site, without adding phases again. Public-source coverage does not establish an exhaustive citywide ranking.
latest_addition.source_dates: Reports range from 2019 to 2026. Checked date is the retrieval/review date, not the design date.
latest_addition.model_status: All ten additions start with their verified City application boundaries and no fabricated 3D building shapes.
